Fasting Shift is built so your health data stays yours. Here is exactly what that means.
Your data stays on this phone
Fasts, logs, check-ins and safety answers are stored only on this device. There is no Fasting Shift server and no cloud copy, and Android\'s automatic backup is turned off for this app.
The database is encrypted with SQLCipher. Its key is protected by the Android Keystore on this phone.
You never sign up or sign in. There is no email or profile to leak.
No ads, no analytics, no trackers
The app contains no advertising, analytics or tracking tools, and your data is never sold or shared for marketing.
What leaves this phone, and when
To buy, restore or check Shift+, the app talks to Google Play and RevenueCat, our purchase service. They see an anonymous app ID and your purchase, never your fasts or health data.
Health Connect: only if you turn it on
If you turn on Health Connect in Settings, the app exchanges only the data types you allow (such as weight and water) with Health Connect on this phone.
Files: only when you export or share
Exports, backups, doctor reports and share cards are created on this phone and go only where you send them.
A challenge link holds only the challenge (type, dates and an optional name). Everyone tracks their own progress on their own phone.
Export a copy of my data
A zip with a full backup and spreadsheet files
Deleting removes everything this app stores on this phone and restarts it fresh. Export first if you want to keep a copy.

Your fasts, logs, check-ins, safety answers, challenges and settings will be permanently removed from this phone. Files you exported and data in Health Connect are not affected. Your Shift+ purchase stays with your Google Play account. This can\'t be undone.
